scope: Eight identical public synthetic WAVs, 2.28–3.72 seconds each; two rounds per model, three CPU threads, one extra isolated model process at a time, existing camera/GUI/memory workers retained, microphone paused.

observed_comparison.interpretation: No observed latency or CPU saving. Fixed order and changing background work prevent claiming these percentages are a stable causal model difference.

paired_text_review.finding: Both retain the request to introduce oneself in two sentences.
Both write 林月 rather than intended 林悦. Baseline retains 喜悦的悦 with a repeated 喜; SenseVoice writes 喜悦的月, losing the character explanation. Candidate is not established as better for name memory.

Both retain 三本书 and 二百五十毫升. Candidate omits baseline's extra 唉. Authored synthesis intent is not a human-gold transcript, so this is an observed textual difference rather than proven acoustic hallucination.
Both retain both negations: 没有关灯 / 没有锁门.
Both retain 更正 / 下午四点 / 不是三点.
Both retain remember, forget, blue key, shelf second level and location query semantics in these public fixtures; no command was routed to Store.

quality_limit: 107 normalized authored-intent characters repeated twice, not 214 independent human-gold characters. Small public synthetic set; no general accuracy pass, real voice, dialect, background speech or false-trigger acceptance.

restoration.interpretation: Later owner observation confirms WAITING_SPEECH and microphone open. Earlier immediate post-resume WAITING_SERVICE is preserved in PAIR evidence. Capture failures remain 3; this snapshot does not establish long-run stability.

followup: Return evidence to the original optimization owner. Further priority, frontend scheduling, streaming ASR integration, or real speech trials require their own measured comparison; this result does not justify a production model switch.
